description.value: Seek & Surf is a husband-and-wife-run surf and skate shop on Sooke Road, anchoring the Juan de Fuca Strait surf community with surfboards, wetsuits, fins, and a curated selection of outdoor lifestyle goods. Founded by Mike and Cas, the shop positions itself as an inclusive gathering place for outdoor enthusiasts rather than a purely transactional retailer. Touring cyclists passing through Sooke may find it worth a stop for dry bags, sun care products, footwear, or simply a welcoming local vibe.

address.value: 5871 Sooke Road, Sooke, British Columbia V9Z 0C3
